# Delayed-font regression fixture

Unmodified Noto Sans KR subset served by Google Fonts, captured in the PR #35 production browser trace. Used only by browser tests; not shipped in the game build. The 16,568-byte fixture gives the test real late-loading font metrics without external font requests.

- Source: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/notosanskr/v40/PbykFmXiEBPT4ITbgNA5Cgm203Tq4JJWq209pU0DPdWuqxJFA4GNDCBYtw.119.woff2
